unlisted_practices: Input sanitization and intent classification before processing requests
Deterministic slot collection with controlled multi-turn clarification instead of guessing
Voice-first interface with chunked text-to-speech output to avoid rushed playback
Co-design of the platform with people with AD/ADRD

screen.reason: Evaluates a conversational agentic system (AI-Care) with four individuals with Alzheimer's disease/dementia to complete everyday task coordination. While safety controls are built into the system architecture, it is a formative pilot study of a newly built system rather than a comparative test of a deployment practice.
